problem:
Find the entry ${r}_{43}$ of the matrix $R$, where 

$$
R=[\begin{aligned}-5 & 2 & \sqrt{3} & 4 \\ -3 & 0 & -4 & 5 \\ 5 & -2 & 8 & -1 \\ 0 & -1 & 1 & \sqrt{2}\end{aligned}].
$$

feedback.problem:
Find the entry ${g}_{22}$ of the matrix $G$, where 

$$
G=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 \\ -1 & 2 & -3 \\ 2 & 1 & -3\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
The entry ${g}_{22}$ lies at the intersection of the $2$nd row and $2$nd column. Therefore, ${g}_{22}=2.$

$$
G=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 \\ -1 & 2 & -3 \\ 2 & 1 & -3\end{aligned}]
$$
